meaning:
παράδοξος, -ον
(παρά, δόξα), [in LXX: Jdth.13:13, Wis.5:2 16:17 19:5, Sir.43:25; 2-4 Mac 3 * ;]
contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous: pl., Luk.5:26.†
SYN.: see: δύναμις (AS)

elsewhere.note: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
